blocks.content: In programming, strings are one the most used data types. It's only natural then that Java comes with multiple inbuilt methods to handle them.
In this lesson, you'll learn about the following methods:

items: length() - finds the length of the string
charAt() - returns a character from the string

blocks.content: Let's start with the length() method.
